scores.success_why: [E] First-hand evidence includes seven website customers in one account, and one client could exceed £1,000; broad competition, AI commoditisation and client acquisition make repeatable sales uncertain.
scores.agent_why: [E] Agents can research verified Ltd prospects, draft sites and handle routine admin, but discovery, revisions, QA and client decisions take Ricardo's time.
scores.fit_why: [E] Technical skills and low startup cost help, but the cluster targets local businesses, breaching a hard constraint and capping fit at 3.
scores.automation_why: [E] Prospect research, drafts and billing can be assisted, but sales, scoping, revisions and QA keep total automation below half.
scores.uk_legal_reason: Demonstrated cold-email targeting is not limited to corporate subscribers. Under Ricardo's constraint, cold email must go only to verified UK limited companies; messages to sole traders and other individual subscribers generally need consent or a valid soft opt-in. Corporate emails still need sender identification and an opt-out.
scores.staleness_note: [E] Evidence runs through October 2026; recheck current AI builder capabilities, tool pricing, hosting terms and UK cold-email rules. Recent revenue claims come from a larger media team, not a solo part-time operator.
scores.one_line: [E] Technically plausible, but the local-business sales premise conflicts with Ricardo's hard constraint.
